content: WebGPURenderer became production-capable around r171, targeting full stable status by end of 2026; auto-falls-back to WebGL2 on unsupported browsers (about 95 percent WebGPU coverage claimed). New Three Shader Language TSL compiles once to WGSL plus GLSL. For this project, WebGLRenderer recommended over WebGPURenderer because the classic GLSL, ShaderMaterial, EffectComposer pipeline needed for hand-written CRT shaders is WebGL-era and better documented and battle-tested there.
